Free Shipping Eligible The Browne Amplification - Gritador Overdrive is a mid's forward overdrive, and so much more. Tube screamer look and sound, the vocal-like mid's cut through the mix to make any guitar and amp sounds great while retaining some upper harmonic compression that is really pleasing and natural. Green LED. Made just down the road in Kansas City, we're excited to have Browne Amplification here at the store! From Browne Amplification : We won't beat around the bush on this because we both know what classic circuit inspired this pedal. From Stevie Ray Vaughn to John Mayer, this Tube Screamer has been part of more recordings than any other overdrive pedal. This version, however, is the version that our resident genius in chief has tweaked to perfection. He dialed in the midrange to be more nuanced. You still get that classic midrange bump but without some of the inherent nasaliness that can sometimes plague this circuit. He altered the clipping to be slightly less symmetrical. He also tweaked the low end to give it more fullness while still maintaining a tight and punchy low end. Why Gritador? Because it means “screamer” in Portuguese. This is Dave's favorite version of his favorite overdrive. Just plug it in and let go. I promise you - this thing SCREAMS. The dimensions of the Gritador are 4.8” x 2.64” x 1.6” (2.25” with knobs) and is powered by a 9V power supply with draw of 20mA. It has soft switching with an adjustable startup state and a beautiful glossy Bullfrog Belly Green, keeping the Gritador in the militaristic aesthetic oved by fans of Browne Amplification.
